I wrote the billing screen to `component.html` in this folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and uses only the tokens from `tokens.css`, which I inlined so the file stands alone. It is static HTML and CSS inside `#component`, 1280px wide.

- **Layout:** White page with a centered 1120px column. "Billing" is the title, set in Unbounded Light capitals.
- **Plan panel:** A card with "Team plan", the price line, "18 of 25 seats used" and a Change Plan button. I made the button the screen's one primary pill, since it's the only action.
- **Invoices:** A card holding the table, with 52px rows, label-style headers and "Paid" status pills.
- **Seat bar:** I added a thin bar under the seats line, filled to 72%, that isn't in your content list. It's easy to delete.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available in this folder, so the browser will fall back to the system font.
